name: Ajaxin
description: Provides a simple modern ajax loading animation during ajaxing.
project_description:
Provides a simple modern ajax progressbar as a replacement for full screen

progressbar, and few AJAX loading animations. Integrated with core AJAX,

Blazy images, and or Intersection Observer ajaxified blocks and its infinite

scroll Views pager.

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 
 Blazy 2.16+ since Ajaxin:1.4 
 
 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install the module as usual, more info can be found on:

 Installing Drupal 8 Modules 

 Back to top 

 Usage / Configuration 
 Visit /admin/config/media/ajaxin 

 Change the background color as needed.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 The module will override loading animations for core AJAX, Blazy images, and or

Intersection Observer ajaxified blocks and its infinite scroll Views pager.

 Back to top 

 Known issues/ limitations 
 
 This module doesn't monitor/ calculate AJAX package, yet. It is only a simple CSS preloader indicating a progress happening. At this stage, accuracy is not crucial. Impression of something in progress is. At best, it just reacts on an event when an AJAX or image has finished loading.
